fieldValues.title: Layers
fieldValues.summary: Layers is an outline of your essay: one row per paragraph, by its title. Click a row to jump to that paragraph. Drag rows to reorder them, or drop one onto another to put it underneath. The eye hides a paragraph (and everything under it) from the page and from the export, without deleting it.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: highlight the Layers panel; explain it is the same paragraphs as the page, in outline.
